question: _______ glands release tears from our eyes.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lacrimal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Lacrimal Glands are paired exocrine glands which secrete the aqueous layer of the tear film, resulting in tears in each eye.
 
• The lacrimal glands are situated in the upper lateral region of each orbit.
 
• In a human eye, lacrimal glands lubricate the eye by producing mucus, resulting in tears. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adrenaline** hormone is secreted by the adrenal gland.

 
 
• Adrenaline hormones are rapidly secreted in response to the stress of any kind and during emergency situations and are called emergency hormones or hormones of Fight or Flight.
 
 
 
• The **pituitary Gland** is present below the hypothalamus.
 
 
• It secretes various hormones, like growth hormone, prolactin, thyroid-stimulating hormone, oxytocin, vasopressin, gonadotropin, etc.
 
 
 
• The **thyroid gland **is a butterfly-shaped gland located at the base of the neck just below** Adam's apple.**
 
 
• This gland produces thyroid hormones, which help regulate the body's metabolism, the chemical processes that occur in the body.
